Órale Padre es comida mexicana de calle hecha en Sevilla: burritos, tacos, nachos y bowls. Nació en 2021 en un local pequeño de la calle San Luis, en la Macarena, y hoy son tres, con una cocina central donde se prepara todo el producto. La cochinita y la carrillada van horas a baja temperatura, y la tortilla se calienta cuando pides, no cuando abrimos. Por eso tardamos quince minutos y no tres. ⇒ Órale Padre is Mexican street food made in Seville: burritos, tacos, nachos and bowls. It was born in 2021 in a small place on Calle San Luis, in the Macarena, and today there are three, with a central kitchen where everything is prepared. The cochinita and the pork cheek cook low and slow for hours, and the tortilla is heated when you order, not when we open. That's why we take fifteen minutes and not three.

One euro spent equals one point on in-store orders (table, bar or pick-up, identifying yourself with your phone number when paying) and two points on pick-up orders placed through the website or our online shop. Orders through delivery platforms (Uber Eats, Glovo) earn no points because the platform doesn't tell us who the customer is. The Compadre and Padrino levels multiply points as shown on the club page.
